title: Wi-Fi access point, local server, and DNS redirection

spans.text: For first-time setup, a device can create a Wi-Fi network and a local control page that a phone can open without internet.

maps names on that network to the board's IP so a setup page is easy to reach. This is a starting point for a captive portal; automatic portal pop-ups vary by phone and operating system. Clearly identify the device and protect any information entered.

The AP does not provide internet by itself. Internet requires a separate STA connection to a router; AP+STA shares radio resources. Test only on a network you control.

spans.caption: Wi-Fi access point, local server, and DNS redirection

spans.title: Important safety and compatibility note
spans.text: Change the password. This simple HTTP portal is not encrypted and must not be exposed to the internet. DNS redirection does not guarantee every phone will show a portal window; test AP+STA on the exact board.
